## Goal
docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md maps the modules but no developer guide explains the per-site state machine and escalation ladder in `src/freemyid/state.py`.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Explains the listing states and allowed moves (`src/freemyid/state.py:18-41`) with a Mermaid diagram whose edges match `TRANSITIONS` exactly, plus the NEEDS_HUMAN/ERROR rule (28, 35-41).
2. Explains what a scan result does (`after_scan` 74-91), when a send counts (43-71), the escalation ladder and its window (100-138, `GRACE_DAYS` 14) and when the next check runs (141-151), and where the runner applies them (`src/freemyid/engine/runner.py`, cite the lines you find).
3. Links to docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md instead of repeating it, and ends with "What this guide does not cover".

Plain English for developers; every claim about the code carries an inline `path:line` citation in the format `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_source_citations.py` parses. Describe what the code does today; anything unreleased is "coming". No key, cipher or secret-handling details (in-house only, docs/VENDOR.md). No real personal data. Offline: no network, no git, no installs.
